what: host re-measurement of allocator_consumed for all 32 cases; no arm, no VM

method.column_asan_pymalloc: PYTHONMALLOC unset, so pymalloc is active
method.column_asan_libc_malloc: PYTHONMALLOC=malloc, which obmalloc.c:640-665 routes RAW, MEM and OBJ to libc
method.rule: a heap report with pymalloc still active means the object is not a pymalloc block (no); a heap report only once pymalloc is off means it is (yes); no heap report in either column measures nothing and is recorded as inconclusive, not as no
method.not_used: region size is not a discriminator: case 07 (gh140594) is a 100-byte non-nested object

routing_control.what: the routing the rule depends on, measured rather than derived
routing_control.reads: the MEM domain is pymalloc by default (obmalloc.c:351 PYMEM_ALLOC = PYMALLOC_ALLOC); only the RAW domain bypasses it
